title: Time Warner, Telecom, and Airport Land Talks
summary:
*   Discussions were held regarding potential litigation against Time Warner Entertainment Company and under new federal and state telecommunications legislation.
*   The city addressed ongoing legal proceedings, specifically the F.M. Properties v. City of Austin lawsuit.
*   Plans were reviewed for acquiring land in Del Valle to expand the Austin-Bergstrom International Airport.
